name: Households with a broadband subscription
source: Census Reporter API, republishing U.S. Census Bureau ACS 2024 5-year table B28002
notes: Exact geography 16000US0611250, Carmel-by-the-Sea; ACS 2020–2024 5-year release (acs2024_5yr), B28002 universe households. Estimate for households with broadband of any type is 1,581 of 1,619 = 97.65%, rounded to 97.7%; published MOEs are ±266 and ±267 respectively, so the estimate is imprecise and should be treated cautiously. Tier 1 city sources reviewed did not provide a household broadband measure. The official Census Bureau ACS API endpoint was inaccessible in this run; Census Reporter API is the tier-3 secondary interface to the underlying ACS, captured with response metadata and MOEs.
